summary: A --dry-run preview skips the learn setup in PersistentPreRunE, the post-run journal entry and the flag-correction pass, so it never opens, migrates or writes local data.
reason: The generated PersistentPreRunE ran the learn init (store open, migration, entity seed) for every command that may write, and Execute() journaled every invocation, whether or not --dry-run was set: a teach --dry-run preview changed local data. Found in the public-library review of PR #2374; the same template ships in every printed CLI.
validated_outcome: TestDryRunLeavesLocalDataAlone (teach --dry-run leaves no store file; a dry-run journal call writes no file while a non-dry-run control does) and TestArgsDryRun; go build, go vet and go test ./... green.
